whenToUse: You look at three values together, such as price, sales, and review count.
You see which area the large items cluster in.
whenNotToUse: Small differences in circle size must be compared.
There are so many items the circles overlap badly (use a scatter plot).
There are only two values (use a scatter plot).

alternatives.name: Scatter Plot
alternatives.reason: Seeing only the relationship between two values.

accessibility: Circle size is proportional to area, not radius, so it doesn't exaggerate.
Item names are written inside the circles, not left to color.
Opening the table view shows every value as a table.
